title: Existence of the module comparison on the coordinate pullback
statement: Choose the shared derived categories and additive tensor pullbacks [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-module-pullback]. Let $f:X\to S$, $g:S'\to S$, $g':X'\to X$, and $f':X'\to S'$ form a cartesian square of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-fibre-product]. Let $G$ be an $\mathcal O_X$-module and $c:Lg'^*(G[0])\to(g'^*G)[0]$ satisfy IsDerivedModulePullbackComparison [def-pc-derived-module-base-change-map]. For arbitrary scheme isomorphisms $e_S:S\cong A$, $e_T:S'\cong B$, set $f_A=f\mathbin{\gg}e_S$, $g_A=e_T^{-1}\mathbin{\gg}g\mathbin{\gg}e_S$, $P=X\times_A B$, $p:P\to X$, $q:P\to B$, and $T=R(e_T^{-1})_*$. There exists $c_0:Lp^*(G[0])\to(p^*G)[0]$ satisfying IsDerivedModulePullbackComparison [def-pc-derived-module-base-change-map]. No compatibility with the original c is asserted.

proof.text: Take p to be the first projection of the chosen pullback. Unpack the specification of derivedPullback p supplied by exists_derivedPullback. Identify its underived functor with tensorPullback p using functor extensionality on the object and map formulas. Evaluate the left-derived counit at G in degree zero and compose with the localized single-complex pullback identification. The resulting comparison satisfies the predicate by definition; the original square and hc are unnecessary.

theorem canonicalModuleBaseChange_iso_comparison_c0
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (a : Y ⟶ Z), (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback a).Additive]
    {X S X' S' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (g : S' ⟶ S)
    (g' : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (_sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (G : X.Modules)
    (c : (derivedPullback g').obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj G) ⟶
        (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X'.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
            ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g').obj G))
    (_hc : IsDerivedModulePullbackComparison g' G c)
    {A B : Scheme.{u}} (eS : S ≅ A) (eT : S' ≅ B) :
    let fA := f ≫ eS.hom
    let gA := eT.inv ≫ g ≫ eS.hom
    ∃ c0 : (derivedPullback (pullback.fst fA gA)).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj G) ⟶
        (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (pullback fA gA).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
            ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst fA gA)).obj G),
      IsDerivedModulePullbackComparison (pullback.fst fA gA) G c0
